## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands run, the environment or hardware used, and any checks that
remain for a maintainer.

## Contribution and license checklist

- [ ] Every commit includes a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute and redistribute every added file.
- [ ] New third-party material records its source, license, and attribution.
- [ ] Dependency changes include refreshed build locks and `.licenses/` files.
- [ ] New NVIDIA-authored source and build files include the required SPDX
      copyright and Apache-2.0 identifiers.
- [ ] No restricted data, unapproved model files, secrets, API keys, or
      credentials are included.
- [ ] Relevant automated and visual checks are listed above.
